label: amend with a message mentioning all
add a file whose name has -A
switch -c then commit
bash: git switch -c fix/readme-spelling && git add README.md && git commit -m "docs: fix spelling"

label: switch -c, add, commit, short
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git add README.md && git commit -m "x"

label: checkout -b then commit
bash: git checkout -b fix/x && git add README.md && git commit -m x

label: switch --create then commit
bash: git switch --create fix/x && git commit -m x

label: switch -C then commit
bash: git switch -C fix/x && git commit -m x

label: checkout -B then commit
bash: git checkout -B fix/x && git commit -m x

label: switch to a topic branch then commit
bash: git switch fix/x && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, echo to a file, add, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && echo hi > f && git add f && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, status, stash, diff, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git status && git stash push && git diff --staged && git commit -m x
